critical_code_review_comments: payroll_config.py:120 falls back to COUNTRY_PROFILES['DO'] when country_code is unknown. Consider logging a WARNING when an unrecognized country_code is found so misconfigured tenants surface in observability instead of silently getting DR rates.

payroll_config.py:139 _label() helper picks employee_deductions[0]/[1] and employer_contributions[0..3] by INDEX. This works for current COUNTRY_PROFILES shape but is fragile — if any country's profile reorders the array (e.g. puts pension before health), labels will swap (sfs label might display the AFP entry). Long-term, switch to lookup-by-code (e.g., find item where code in {'SFS','HEALTH','SALUD'}) instead of positional indexing.

i18n FR locale has 430 keys missing vs ES (pre-existing, unrelated to iter246 — but a future sprint should run /app/backend/scripts/i18n_audit.py and patch them, especially accounting.* and geoLocationsPage.liveMap.*). EN has 3 still-missing keys (geoLocationsPage.liveMap.{employeeToast,filters.activeFilters,locationToast}) — also pre-existing.
